description: Any map from \(\mathbb N\) to an arithmetic structure preserving zero and successor equals the map that interprets every natural number as its numeral.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderArithmetic.canonical_map_unique.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] (f : ℕ → M)
  (hz : f 0 = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)
  (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), f (n + 1) = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M (f n)) :
  f = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M
